state.description: Current state of the presentation flow

role.description: Role of this agent in the flow

requestedCredentials.description: The credentials, and attributes of them, that this flow asked for

credentialDefinitionId.description: AnonCreds credential definition the presentation is restricted to

jsonSchemaCredentialId.description: JSON Schema Credential the presentation is restricted to

attributes.description: Attributes asked of this credential. Every attribute of the schema when omitted.

claims.description: Every claim revealed by the presentation, in one list. It does not identify the credential of a claim: see `credentials`. Empty until the holder answers.

credentials.description: The presented credentials that the agent verified: one entry for each entry of `requestedCredentials`, in the same order. Empty when the agent is the prover, before the trust decision succeeds, and when it fails.

credentialDefinitionId.description: Credential definition of the presented credential

issuerDid.description: The `issuerId` of the credential definition. The agent found an active ISSUER `Participant` for this DID.

credentialSchemaId.description: Identifier of the `CredentialSchema` of the credential

ecosystemDid.description: The `did` of the Ecosystem that owns the `CredentialSchema`

claims.description: The claims that this credential revealed

unrevealed.description: The names of the requested attributes that the holder did not reveal. The proof verifies without them.

rejectedCredentials.description: The requested credentials that failed the trust decision, with the cause of each. The agent verified none of their values. Empty unless the trust decision failed.

index.description: Position of the requested credential in `requestedCredentials`

note.description: The cause, as text for an operator
note.example: did:webvh:QmIssuerC:issuer-c.example holds no active ISSUER Participant for the CredentialSchema 12

credentialDefinitionId.description: Credential definition that the proof names for the credential, when it names one

issuerDid.description: The `issuerId` of that credential definition, when the agent resolved it

credentialSchemaId.description: The `CredentialSchema` that the agent derived from that credential definition

verified.description: Whether the proof verified and the trust decision succeeded. False until the trust decision completes, and false with an `errorMessage` when the flow is `abandoned`.

errorMessage.description: Error message on the exchange. The agent sets it when the exchange stops. The agent also sets it when it declines an exchange and the peer gets no problem report.

updatedAt.description: When the flow was last updated
